text:
With gratitude to Mike Dobbs
Chief Executive Officer
February 2016 – March 2026

Your passion for our mission is part of
the foundation of Camp Southern Ground.
Thank you for years of service to our Founder, our donors, and the many people who have come here and found their remedy in the love we share.
We are grateful for your steadfast leadership and unwavering commitment.
Your legacy is sown in Southern Ground.
